nodes.name: Qualcomm
nodes.description: Public US-listed (Nasdaq) robotics SoC supplier; markets the Dragonwing IQ10 series premium-tier onboard 'brain of the robot' processor for full-size humanoids and AMRs, and is collaborating with Figure on humanoid compute architecture. Merchant alternative to NVIDIA Jetson Thor for onboard AI compute.

nodes.name: NXP Semiconductors
nodes.description: Public US-listed (Nasdaq) semiconductor supplier; provides i.MX 95 applications processor (machine-vision edge node) and i.MX RT1180 crossover MCUs aggregated by an S32J TSN switch for humanoid motor control, developed with NVIDIA as distributed edge-perception/motor-control complements to the central robot brain. Spans onboard compute SoC and real-time motor-control MCU components.

nodes.name: Fuzhou Rockchip Electronics
nodes.description: Public China-listed (Shanghai) application-processor SoC designer; its RK3588/RK3588S edge SoC (octa-core, ~6 TOPS NPU) is the adopted main compute/'brain' platform in multiple Chinese humanoid robots (e.g. AgiBot/ZhiYuan Lingxi X2, LimX Oli). Low-cost merchant onboard-compute alternative to NVIDIA Jetson Thor for domestic humanoids.

nodes.name: D-Robotics
nodes.description: Privately held robot-chip spinoff of Horizon Robotics (HKEX: 9660; D-Robotics shares a technological lineage and coordinated roadmaps with it but is a separate, Series-A-funded company). Makes the RDK S100 — the industry's first single-SoC platform integrating robot 'brain' (compute) and 'cerebellum' (control), 80-128 TOPS — for developers of humanoid robots. Merchant onboard compute-control SoC.

nodes.name: Infineon Technologies
nodes.description: Public Germany-listed (Frankfurt) power-semiconductor and MCU supplier; for humanoid motor control provides gate drivers, current sensors, a GaN-based motor-control chip set, and PSOC Control C3 MCUs (FOC, EtherCAT) that pair with NVIDIA Jetson Thor via Holoscan Sensor Bridge (Aug 2025 NVIDIA collaboration). Merchant motor-drive power-electronics and real-time MCU supplier.

nodes.name: Efficient Power Conversion (EPC)
nodes.description: Privately held (El Segundo, CA) gallium-nitride (GaN) power-semiconductor maker; offers the EPC91122 3-phase BLDC motor-drive inverter evaluation board engineered specifically for humanoid robot joint applications, plus GaN parts for compact wrist/finger/toe motors. Merchant GaN motor-drive/gate-driver-inverter supplier for humanoid actuators.

nodes.name: Microchip Technology
nodes.description: Public US-listed (Nasdaq) microcontroller and analog supplier; its dsPIC33 DSC-based integrated motor drivers combine a digital signal controller, a three-phase MOSFET gate driver, and LIN/CAN FD into one device for FOC BLDC/PMSM motor control. Merchant motor-drive MCU + gate-driver supplier applicable to humanoid joint/actuator drive (robotics/industrial motor-control class, humanoid design win not yet confirmed).

edges.claim: Qualcomm markets the Dragonwing IQ10 series as a premium-tier onboard AI compute ('brain of the robot') processor for full-size humanoid robots; merchant alternative to NVIDIA Jetson Thor.
NXP's i.MX 95 applications processor serves as a machine-vision edge-perception compute node delivering high-bandwidth data to the humanoid robot brain (developed with NVIDIA).
NXP supplies a humanoid motor-control solution built on a kinematic chain of i.MX RT1180 crossover MCUs aggregated by an S32J TSN switch connecting to the robot brain.
Rockchip's RK3588/RK3588S SoC is the adopted onboard compute/'brain' platform in multiple named Chinese humanoid robots (e.g. AgiBot/ZhiYuan Lingxi X2, LimX Oli).
D-Robotics' RDK S100 is the first single-SoC platform integrating robot 'brain' (compute) and 'cerebellum' (control) for humanoid-robot developers (80-128 TOPS).
Infineon supplies gate drivers, current sensors, and a GaN-based motor-control chip set for humanoid-robot motor control (Aug 2025 NVIDIA collaboration).
Infineon's PSOC Control C3 MCU family implements field-oriented motor control for humanoid robots and bridges to NVIDIA Jetson Thor via the Holoscan Sensor Bridge.
EPC's EPC91122 3-phase BLDC motor-drive inverter evaluation board is engineered specifically for humanoid robot joint applications (GaN power stage for joint actuator drive).

Microchip's dsPIC33 DSC-based integrated motor drivers fuse a DSC, a three-phase MOSFET gate driver, and LIN/CAN FD into one device for FOC BLDC/PMSM motor control (robotics/industrial-class; humanoid design win not yet demonstrated on source).

evidence.title: Qualcomm Introduces a Full Suite of Robotics Technologies, Powering Physical AI from Household Robots up to Full-Size Humanoids
evidence.summary: Qualcomm press release positioning the Dragonwing IQ10 series as a premium-tier onboard 'brain of the robot' processor for humanoids/AMRs and citing a Figure collaboration on humanoid compute architecture. Supports Qualcomm as a merchant onboard-AI-compute supplier candidate (alternative to NVIDIA Jetson Thor).
evidence.excerpt: The Qualcomm Dragonwing™ IQ10 Series is its leading and latest addition to premium-tier robotics processors for humanoids and advanced autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). ... delivering high performance, energy-efficient 'Brain of the Robot' capabilities. ... Figure and Qualcomm Technologies are collaborating to define the next generation of compute architecture as Figure scales their humanoid platforms.
evidence.limitations: Vendor press release; names a Figure collaboration but does not prove selected BOM, design-win volume, qualification, or pricing. Quote assembled from non-contiguous sentences on the same release.

evidence.title: NXP and NVIDIA collaborate on edge computing platform for humanoid robots
evidence.summary: Trade-press coverage of NXP's humanoid-robot edge portfolio: an i.MX 95 machine-vision compute node and an i.MX RT1180 crossover-MCU motor-control chain aggregated by an S32J TSN switch, feeding the central robot brain. Supports NXP as a merchant supplier for both onboard compute SoC and real-time motor-control MCU.
evidence.excerpt: The first Holoscan Sensor Bridge-ready solutions in NXP's robotic portfolio include a machine vision solution based on the i.MX 95 applications processor delivering high-bandwidth data to the robot brain. It also includes a motor control solution based on a kinematic chain of i.MX RT1180 crossover MCUs, aggregated by NXP's S32J TSN switch directly connecting to the brain.
evidence.limitations: Trade-press secondary source (not primary IR); describes a reference architecture/portfolio, not a proven design win on a specific shipping humanoid. NXP i.MX here is a distributed edge/motor-control complement to NVIDIA's central compute, not the top-end policy SoC.

evidence.title: What Processor Is Used in Domestic Humanoid Robots?
evidence.summary: 36Kr survey of which compute SoCs Chinese humanoid robots use; names Rockchip RK3588/RK3588S adoption in specific humanoid models. Supports Rockchip as a merchant onboard-compute supplier to humanoids.
evidence.excerpt: RK3588 and RK3588S chips have been adopted by humanoid robots such as ZHIYUAN Lingxi X2, Zhujidongli LimX Oli, and Gaoqing Pi/Pi +.
evidence.limitations: Trade-press secondary source naming robot models; not the robot makers' own BOM disclosure. RK3588 (~6 TOPS) is a high-level-control/low-cost SoC, below NVIDIA Jetson Thor / D-Robotics S100 in raw AI throughput.

evidence.title: Chip Designer Spun Off From China's Horizon Robotics Raises USD100 Million in Series A Round
evidence.summary: Yicai report that D-Robotics — a private robot-chip spinoff of Horizon Robotics — is launching the RDK S100, the first single-SoC platform integrating compute and control, for humanoid-robot developers. Supports D-Robotics as a private merchant onboard compute-control SoC supplier and clarifies its (separate) relationship to Horizon Robotics (9660.HK).
evidence.excerpt: D-Robotics, a one-year-old robot chip spinoff from Chinese autonomous driving firm Horizon Robotics ... has completed a USD100 million Series A funding round ... The company plans to launch the RDK S100 robot development kit next month. It will be the industry's first system-on-chip platform to integrate computing and control functions into a single unit ... designing foundational computing chips for developers of humanoid robots, quadruped robot dogs, logistics robots, and robotic vacuum cleaners.
evidence.limitations: D-Robotics is private (no ticker); 9660.HK belongs to parent-lineage Horizon Robotics, a separate listed entity. RDK S100 was pre-launch at the time of this report; design-win volumes on shipping humanoids not proven here.

evidence.title: Infineon to enable humanoid robots with precise motion and efficiency with NVIDIA technology
evidence.summary: Trade-press coverage of Infineon's Aug 2025 humanoid-robotics announcement (with NVIDIA): PSOC Control C3 MCUs for FOC motor control, gate drivers, current sensors, and a GaN-based motor-control chip set. Supports Infineon as a merchant supplier of humanoid motor-drive power electronics (gate drivers/current sensors) and real-time motor-control MCUs.
evidence.excerpt: Infineon provides its PSOC Control C3 family of microcontrollers, which integrate seamlessly with the Nvidia Holoscan Sensor Bridge to the Nvidia Jetson Thor series modules ... The integration of Infineon's gate drivers and current sensors helps control communication and design challenges in humanoid robotics ... Additionally, Infineon provides a full motor control chip set including the company's latest transistor technology based on gallium nitride (GaN) for high-density and best-efficiency motor control solutions.
evidence.limitations: Trade-press secondary source carrying Infineon's press-release claims; describes Infineon's product portfolio/reference path with NVIDIA, not a proven design win or BOM on a specific shipping humanoid. Excerpt assembled from non-contiguous sentences in the same article.

evidence.title: EPC adds 3-phase BLDC motor drive inverter evaluation board for humanoid robot joint applications
evidence.summary: Trade-press coverage of EPC's EPC91122 GaN 3-phase BLDC motor-drive inverter evaluation board engineered for humanoid robot joint applications. Supports EPC as a merchant GaN motor-drive/inverter (gate-driver-class power stage) supplier for humanoid actuators.
evidence.excerpt: EPC91122, a high-performance 3-phase brushless DC (BLDC) motor drive inverter evaluation board specifically engineered for humanoid robot joint applications. ... The EPC91122 is suitable for humanoid robot joints, compact servo drives, robotics, drones, and eMobility platforms.
evidence.limitations: Trade-press secondary source describing an evaluation board (reference design), not a confirmed production design win on a shipping humanoid. EPC is private (no ticker). Excerpt assembled from non-contiguous sentences in the same article.

evidence.title: Microchip's dsPIC DSC-based integrated motor drivers
evidence.summary: Trade-press coverage of Microchip's dsPIC33 DSC-based integrated motor drivers that combine a digital signal controller, a three-phase MOSFET gate driver, and LIN/CAN FD into one device for BLDC/PMSM FOC motor control. Supports Microchip as a merchant motor-drive MCU + gate-driver supplier of the IC class used in robot joint/actuator drive.
evidence.excerpt: These devices incorporate a dsPIC33 digital signal controller (DSC), a three-phase MOSFET gate driver and optional LIN or CAN FD transceiver into one package. A significant benefit of this integration is reduction in component count of the motor control system design, smaller printed circuit board (PCB) dimensions and reduced complexity.
evidence.limitations: Source describes the integrated-motor-driver IC class for general BLDC/PMSM (robotics/industrial/automotive) motor control; it does not name a humanoid-robot design win — hence edge is reported_capable_supplier, not manufactured_by. Excerpt assembled from non-contiguous sentences in the same article.
